game.name: Install Decky Loader
game.desc: Installs Steam Deck's Decky Loader plugin system for Steam (Big Picture), plus a small watcher that re-injects the Decky menu when Steam launches so it keeps working across nightly updates. Re-run any time to repair or reinstall. Requires Steam.

game.name: Uninstall Decky Loader
game.desc: Removes Decky Loader: stops and disables the plugin service, removes the boot watcher and the homebrew tree (loader, plugins and settings).
